governingPrinciple: AI Council motion represents observable state becoming useful structure. Temporary activity should disappear when work resolves; evidence, decisions, authority, outcomes, and memory should remain as durable product state.

counterpoint.guardrail: Motion improves comprehension and does not turn answers into staged editorial presentations.

decisionSpine.guardrail: Directional lines or settlement appear only where a real relationship, chronology, or provenance chain exists.

threshold.guardrail: Threshold never becomes ordinary loading, navigation, conversation, or post-authorization ambient styling.

signatureBehaviors.rule: A temporary work-state indication should resolve into the durable information it produced whenever such information exists.
Approval begins in advisory calm. Consequence styling appears only when approval-required becomes true.
Execution and validation progress disappear into a durable outcome/history record rather than ending in celebration.
A real failure halts movement and establishes a clear recovery state rather than increasing visual noise.
Mobile uses fewer simultaneous moving elements and focused sheet/state transitions rather than compressed desktop choreography.

semanticConstitution.rule: Operational state describes what the system is actually doing. Motion role describes what product transition an event may visually cause. Neither may be inferred from the other.
semanticConstitution.authorityInvariant: approval-required has operationalState none and motionRole authority-transition until actual execution begins.
semanticConstitution.navigationInvariant: opening project/thread navigation is a navigation transition, not loading, unless a separate resource request is actually pending.

timingPhilosophy.rule: Timing ranges are behavioral guidance, not pixel-level frozen choreography. Information becoming ready should feel responsive; consequence may be more deliberate because semantics changed.

reducedMotion.principle: Remove nonessential translation, drawing, looping movement, and staged delay while preserving wording, hierarchy, authority, provenance, focus, and final state.

banned: animated agent avatars or imaginary specialist dialogue
typewriter animation as universal answer behavior
constant ambient gradient or border movement
Threshold consequence language in ordinary conversation or navigation
notFrozen: retry, rollback, partial-failure, and interruption choreography
